Title: (question) stuck minion, spirit marionette and resolved action

Messages.Author: gu...@mail.goo.ne.jp
Messages.Body:
Hi all,

I have an empty vampire with Pulled Fang. Someone plays Spirit
Marionette on him. Now that vampire must hunt and cannot, which
woulda send him to torpor.

My question is whether that hunt action is ended or not. My guess is
yes, but I am not sure. This is important because the control effect
from Spirit Marionette lasts "until the end of the next action".

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


He must hunt, but cannot hunt. So there is no "that hunt action".

He goes to torpor instead.

Messages.Author: Salem
Messages.Body:
